description: THE SCHEMA OF QUALIA SPACE — one typed-dimensional space over Concepts. A QualiaDimension codebook of typed AXES a concept's meaning is organised along, in three families: lexical (Pustejovsky FORMAL/CONSTITUTIVE/TELIC/AGENTIVE — what a concept IS, seeded, the backbone already half-present in frame_harvest/metonymy_patterns); dynamical (the CAN field coordinates valence/commitment/pull/activation read off state/external_field/identity_field — the proto-phenomenal 'what it is like', crystallised axes IN the signature + live axes read as an OVERLAY, per h_eff=external+identity in can_ops.rs); and phenomenal (felt axes beyond the raw fields, only a bootstrap modality seeded — the rest MINTED from residual like the sd-loop's CapabilityAxis, so the space is grown not pre-cut). Lexical and phenomenal are ONE space, not two: the substrate already stores emotion/regard/self-worth as Concepts in the same CAN field as any reasoned-about concept. A DimensionEdgeRole map wires edge types to their lexical role. A QualiaSchema descriptor node declares the value domain of each coordinate family + the invariants a built space must hold (checked by domains/qualia_schema.validate_qualia_space). Emitted by tools/build_qualia_space_seed.py. Read by domains/analogy_search.concept_signature (dimension-tagged coordinates); matched per-dimension by seeds/analogy_search.json.

microtheory.name: qualia_space
microtheory.description: the typed dimensional space a concept's shape lives in; lexical + dynamical + (grown) phenomenal axes, one space

attrs.name: lexical:formal
attrs.gloss: FORMAL — what KIND of thing it is (its taxonomic type / is_a / category). Distinguishes it within a larger domain.

attrs.name: lexical:constitutive
attrs.gloss: CONSTITUTIVE — what it is MADE OF / its parts / material / the whole it belongs to (whole•part, container•content).

attrs.name: lexical:telic
attrs.gloss: TELIC — what it is FOR: its function, purpose, the role it plays (artifact•function).

attrs.name: lexical:agentive
attrs.gloss: AGENTIVE — how it COMES ABOUT: its origin, what brings it into being or drives it (creator•creation, cause•effect).

attrs.name: dynamical:valence
attrs.gloss: VALENCE — sign of the concept's committed state (−/0/+). The coarsest felt axis: is this, standingly, a negative, neutral, or positive thing to the agent. Crystallised.

attrs.name: dynamical:commitment
attrs.gloss: COMMITMENT — the identity_field: the long-standing structural commitment that resists perturbation and survives decay (can_ops.rs). The CRYSTALLISED axis — how settled the agent's feeling about this has become. Experience turned to character.

attrs.name: dynamical:pull
attrs.gloss: PULL — the external_field: the LIVE, time-varying evidence pulling on the concept right now, which decays (can_ops.rs). OVERLAY only — how the agent feels about this AT THIS MOMENT, before it settles. The gap between pull and commitment is 'I'm not sure how I feel about this.'

attrs.name: dynamical:activation
attrs.gloss: ACTIVATION — the current state magnitude, live. How active / engaged the concept is in the agent's present processing. OVERLAY only.

attrs.name: dynamical:disposition
attrs.gloss:
DISPOSITION — the agent's COGNITIVE DISPOSITION as a felt, CAN-relaxable trait: its standing willingness to mint referents / form associations, conservative (−) ↔ permissive (+). A REAL dynamical qualia axis on the AGENT (domains/disposition.py), the structural TWIN of self-worth (can_self_worth_bridge.py): a felt scalar on a resident CAN Concept, SEEDED with a starting temperament but PRODUCED/moved by the SAME can_native_identity_field_feedback dynamics as any other crystallised feeling. `disposition_field` is the crystallised STANDING trait — a mechanical mirror of the `identity_field` the native rule steps toward the sign of sustained disposition evidence (never hand-written mid-drive; the mirror copies what the relaxation produced).
GRANULARITY (honest, measured — scripts/qualia_disposition_demo.py): UNLIKE dynamical:commitment (which SATURATES to {−4,0,+4} because quantum=0.25 clamps identity_field's very first ±1 step to ±4), disposition has quantum=1.0 = the field's OWN integer step size. can_native_identity_field_feedback moves identity_field by exactly ±1 per strictly-later tick (verified: sustained +σ gives identity_field 1,2,3,4,5,…), so quantum=1.0/half_width=4 renders identity_field=1→k=1, 2→2, 3→3, 4→4 and only CLAMPS at ≥5. That is a GENUINELY GRADED 9-level axis (−4…+4): the seeded starting temperaments (e.g. −2 conservative, 0 neutral, +2 open) read as distinct coordinates, and sustained evidence walks the level up/down one step at a time. The underlying field DOES take those graded integer values under the dynamics — the spread is real, not a quantiser illusion. (A wider magnitude would still be bounded by the ±1-per-tick step the rule uses for Lyapunov stability; the levels are the field's own, honestly reported.)

attrs.name: dynamical:disposition_pull
attrs.gloss: DISPOSITION_PULL — the LIVE, momentary openness pulling on the agent's disposition right now (the external_field of the disposition Concept, mirrored to `disposition_external`), before it settles into the standing trait. OVERLAY only — mirrors the valence(crystallised)/pull(overlay) split: the GAP between disposition_pull and disposition is 'I am being pulled toward opening up right now but my standing temperament has not moved.' quantum=1.0/half_width=4 as for the crystallised axis, so a live pull and a standing trait at the same level read as the same coordinate.

attrs.name: dynamical:abstraction
attrs.gloss: ABSTRACTION — the agent's standing pull toward high-order, structural mappings: concrete/surface (−) ↔ abstract/deep (+). A component of the cognitive-style VECTOR (domains/disposition.TRAIT_REGISTRY), its OWN CAN Concept in the agent_disposition Mt, PRODUCED/moved by the same can_native_identity_field_feedback dynamics as openness but INDEPENDENT of it (a separate Concept, its own field). Seeded NEUTRAL (0.0) and INERT in layer 1 (no consumer); layer 2 wires it to analogy order_n. quantum=1.0/half_width=4 — the graded 9-level scheme.

attrs.name: dynamical:abstraction_pull
attrs.gloss: ABSTRACTION_PULL — the LIVE, momentary pull on this trait right now (the external_field of the trait Concept, mirrored to `abstraction_external`), before it settles into the standing trait. OVERLAY only — the gap between the live pull and the standing trait is 'I'm being pulled but my temperament has not moved.' quantum=1.0/half_width=4 as for the crystallised axis.

attrs.name: dynamical:skepticism
attrs.gloss: SKEPTICISM — the agent's standing demand for evidence before accepting a correspondence: credulous (−) ↔ skeptical (+). A component of the cognitive-style VECTOR, its OWN CAN Concept in the agent_disposition Mt, PRODUCED/moved by the same identity-feedback dynamics but INDEPENDENT of openness and abstraction. Seeded NEUTRAL (0.0) and INERT in layer 1 (no consumer); layer 2 wires it to analogy min_score/recurrence. quantum=1.0/half_width=4 — the graded 9-level scheme.

attrs.name: dynamical:skepticism_pull
attrs.gloss: SKEPTICISM_PULL — the LIVE, momentary pull on this trait right now (the external_field of the trait Concept, mirrored to `skepticism_external`), before it settles into the standing trait. OVERLAY only — the gap between the live pull and the standing trait is 'I'm being pulled but my temperament has not moved.' quantum=1.0/half_width=4 as for the crystallised axis.

attrs.name: phenomenal:modality
attrs.gloss: MODALITY — the sensory/affective register a felt concept belongs to (visual, somatic, emotional, cognitive...). BOOTSTRAP only: the phenomenal family exists so minted axes have a home, but its members are grown from residual, never hand-enumerated (contrast the closed lexical backbone).

attrs.name: phenomenal:sharpness
attrs.gloss: SHARPNESS — a felt crossmodal scalar: how SPIKY/PEAKED (+) vs ROUND/SMOOTH (−) a concept feels, on ONE axis shared across sensory registers. The bouba/kiki (Köhler 1929; Ramachandran & Hubbard 2001) axis: a phonetic FORM and a visual SHAPE that sound-symbolically match land at the SAME pole here. The coordinate is DERIVED INDEPENDENTLY on each side by pre-existing, independently-motivated extractors — articulatory phonetics for a word (voiceless/constriction/spread/front/high → sharp), curvature geometry for a shape (curvature CONCENTRATION: a star peaks, a circle is uniform → round) — and quantised through the SAME _round_to_vocab lattice as the CAN dynamical axes. field:sharpness (read like a dynamical field, so a concept WITHOUT the derived `sharpness` attr gets NO coordinate — default==today), quantum=1.0/half_width=1 = a clean bipolar {−1,0,+1} sign axis. The MATCH is EMERGENT (two independent derivations, one shared axis), not hand-wired: reverse the phonemes or the shape's points and the coordinate FLIPS. GROWN, not backbone (family phenomenal, OPEN).

The dimension tag is what makes the space a schema."], ["dimension_declared", "every coordinate's dimension is either a declared QualiaDimension or an open-family axis (attr:/relational:/phenomenal:)", "A closed-family coordinate (lexical/dynamical/vocab) must name a dimension in the codebook; an open-family coordinate may name any axis of its prefix."], ["value_in_domain", "every coordinate's value lies in its family's declared value domain", "A FIELD-sourced axis's value (any family \u2014 the CAN dynamical axes AND a field-sourced phenomenal axis like sharpness) is an integer step in [-half_width, half_width]\\{0}; a lexical/vocab/attr/relational value and a keyword-sourced phenomenal value is a token/slot-string. A raw field leaking in as attr:* would be a non-discriminative duplicate; its absence is the schema enforcing 'valence/commitment are produced, not hand-set'."], ["no_can_bookkeeping", "no CAN mechanism counter (identity/evidence ledger, *_tick/*_epoch gate) appears as an attr:* coordinate", "The native rules write per-Concept bookkeeping; it is mechanism, not qualia content, and is excluded at the signature source."], ["overlay_superset_of_crystallised", "the overlay signature is a superset of the crystallised one; the axes it adds are exactly the overlay dynamical axes", "h_eff = external + identity read as coordinates: the standing term is in the crystallised signature, the live term is the overlay. Their GAP is the unsettled point ('I'm not sure how I feel')."], ["dark_when_unrelaxed", "a concept with no dynamical field activity carries only non-dynamical (lexical/vocab/attr) coordinates", "A never-relaxed concept is dark on the dynamical axes rather than trivially matching every other concept at valence 0 \u2014 the zero coordinate is omitted, so absence is meaningful."], ["commitment_iff_identity", "dynamical:commitment is present in the crystallised signature iff identity_field rounds to a nonzero step", "Commitment is crystallised experience: it appears only once the identity field has settled away from zero, never before."]]
attrs.gloss: THE SCHEMA OF QUALIA SPACE, made checkable. Declares the value DOMAIN of each coordinate family and the INVARIANTS a built space must hold. A coordinate is (dimension, predicate, value); its family (prefix before ':') fixes predicate+value shape. Read by domains/qualia_schema.validate_qualia_space to check a built space conforms; the QualiaDimension nodes carry the per-axis quantum/half_width/overlay this descriptor references.
